context:
Goal: a triage session on your Mac does triage's work, roadmap pushes included, as cloud triage does.
Problem (rule): only a cloud session's tags prove its tier today, so a Mac session cannot prove it is triage and the guards refuse its roadmap pushes.
Based on (read): coordinator asked you in chat at 16:34 CST; no answer by 16:46 CST.
Based on (read): owner words today are override and opus, typed by you, which Claude cannot write.
Departs from: main, where only cloud tags prove a tier — adds a third owner word, tier triage.

options.gain: Mac triage works like cloud triage, and only you can grant the tier.
options.how: You type 'tier triage' in a Mac session to mark it triage; 'tier off' ends it. It is stored in a state folder Claude cannot write.
options.label: Owner word 'tier triage'
options.lose: One more word to remember and type.

options.how: Mac triage hands each roadmap push to cloud triage.
options.label: No fix
options.lose: Mac triage waits on a cloud session for every push.

title: Should you type 'tier triage' to mark a session on your Mac as triage, so it can push the roadmap?
why: It keeps the tier in your hands, the same way override and opus are.
